visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a human hand in the foreground, with the index finger extended and pointing toward a group of students standing in a classroom. The students, a mix of boys and girls, are dressed in matching orange and black school uniforms. The background features a large projector screen displaying the text 'Don't just dream it DoDo it' with a small lightning bolt icon and the 'Do' logo in the corner. The room is brightly lit by overhead fluorescent lights, casting a neutral and clean glow over the scene. (2) The scene cuts to the students arranged in two opposing rows, engaging in a mock tug-of-war activity. They lean back and mimic the tension of pulling a heavy rope, though no physical rope is visible. The foreground shows rows of blue classroom chairs, establishing the setting as a school lecture hall or auditorium. (3) A new phase begins as the camera captures the students standing together, smiling and posing with their hands on their hips. A taller male in a dark grey t-shirt stands in the center of the group, seemingly leading the activity. (4) In a series of rapid cuts, groups of three students jump toward the camera in a synchronized manner, displaying high energy and excitement. (5) The entire group is then shown standing in a line, performing a deep bow in unison before straightening up to wave enthusiastically and make peace signs at the camera. (6) The final phase features close-ups of individual students who briefly hold up white sheets of paper with single, large black Chinese characters printed on them, such as '跳' and '脫', before walking out of the frame.
